modules.responsibility: Parse commands and delegate to bounded application operations without owning music-processing algorithms.
inputs: command-line arguments and explicit local paths
outputs: exit status and delegated operation presentation
caller_obligations: supply explicit paths and command options
side_effects: delegated operations may write only through their own explicit contracts
errors: invalid commands and rejected application operations are presented without broadening authority
modules.authority_boundary: Command invocation does not imply musical approval, model approval or rights authority.

modules.responsibility: Hide bounded localhost transport, byte ranges and owner-only atomic review persistence from review-specific policy.
inputs: review-specific handlers and bounded local requests
outputs: byte-range responses and explicitly persisted review state
errors: malformed ranges, oversized bodies and unsafe persistence requests fail closed
modules.authority_boundary: Transport and playback never create a musical decision or selection.

modules.responsibility: Hide safe-name, no-follow traversal and exclusive publication mechanics for private directories.
caller_obligations: use a fresh destination and preserve the operation-specific evidence contract
side_effects: owner-only filesystem creation and atomic publication
errors: unsafe names, links, collisions and incomplete publication fail closed
modules.authority_boundary: Successful persistence does not approve the musical or model content being persisted.

modules.responsibility: Keep automatic published primaries distinct from human Workbench decisions.
caller_obligations: do not reinterpret an automatic choice as reviewed approval
errors: ambiguous or unauthorized candidates remain unselected
modules.authority_boundary: Automated scores and defaults never create a human-reviewed decision.

modules.responsibility: Validate retained full-song recovery requests and reports without owning execution, publication, rendering or model machinery.
inputs: full-song recovery plan, request and report mappings
outputs: defensive validated copies and deterministic document hashes
caller_obligations: continue to use the recovery facade for execution and publication
errors: invalid identity, evidence, accounting, effects or preservation bindings fail closed
modules.authority_boundary: A valid recovery document remains resource-incomplete review evidence; validation does not authorize a model run, source selection, musical approval, render or publication.
